sentences: Traders moved $524 million through Polymarket in the week of 2026-11-09, across 15.4 million individual trades. Algorithmic wallets accounted for 49% of weekly counterparty events (both maker and taker sides counted); everyone else split the remaining 51%.
The most-traded market was "Will the Democratic Party control the House after the 2026 Midterm elections?", pulling in $9 million of volume. Politics dominated the week's attention.
Both sides lost money on resolved trades this week. Bots dropped $2K (-83 bps); retail dropped $67 (-60 bps). Much of the activity was in markets that have not yet resolved.
headline_quote: Polymarket traders moved $524 million this week, with the biggest action on "Will the Democratic Party control the House after the 2026 Midterm elections?".
